# American Kennel Club

> The American Kennel Club (AKC) is the authoritative registry and information hub for dog breeds, competitions, training, and ownership resources.

AKC serves as the primary resource for dog breed standards, event management, training programs, and expert advice on dog ownership. The organization maintains comprehensive breed registries, hosts major dog sports competitions including agility and dock diving, and provides educational content for dog owners and enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Dog Breeds
- Breed Registry
- Dog Sports
- Dog Training
- Obedience
- Agility
- Dock Diving

## Core Resources

- [American Kennel Club](https://www.akc.org): AKC homepage: breed registry, standards, and dog information hub
- [Dog Breeds - Types Of Dogs - American Kennel Club](https://www.akc.org/dog-breeds): Complete AKC breed directory with groups, standards, and breed comparison
- [Expert Advice – American Kennel Club](https://www.akc.org/expert-advice): AKC expert advice hub covering breeds, health, training, and resources

## Dog Breeds & Standards

- [Dog Breeds – American Kennel Club](https://www.akc.org/expert-advice/dog-breeds): Comprehensive dog breed guide with history, preservation, and expert advice
- [Labrador Retriever Dog Breed Information](https://www.akc.org/dog-breeds/labrador-retriever): Labrador Retriever breed profile with standards, history, and characteristics
- [Meet the Most Popular Dog Breeds of 2025](https://www.akc.org/expert-advice/dog-breeds/most-popular-dog-breeds-2025): 2025 most popular dog breeds ranking featuring French Bulldog statistics

## Sports & Events

- [Sports & Events Archive – American Kennel Club](https://akc.org/sports): AKC sports, events, and championships directory for dog competitions
- [American Kennel Club - Event Search](https://www.apps.akc.org/event-search): AKC event search tool for dog shows and breed competitions
- ['Sully' the Dock Diving Saint Bernard Makes a Super-Sized Splash](https://www.akc.org/expert-advice/news/diving-dogs-premier-cup-sully-saint-bernard): Feature on Saint Bernard Sully competing in dock diving championships
- [Afghan Hound 'Dazzle' Sparkles at National Agility Championship](https://www.akc.org/expert-advice/news/nation-agility-championship-afghan-hound-dazzle): News story on Afghan Hound Dazzle's success at AKC Agility Championship
- [Weimaraner 'Gauge' Overcomes Illness, Proves Dog Sport Success Is Never Too Late](https://www.akc.org/expert-advice/news/diving-dogs-premier-cup-weimaraner-gauge): Success story of Weimaraner Gauge in dock diving despite health challenges

## Training & Behavior

- [Dog Training: How to Train a Dog & Dog Obedience Training](https://www.akc.org/expert-advice/training): Expert guide on dog training, obedience, and behavior improvement tips
- [Dog Training – American Kennel Club](https://www.akc.org/products-services/training-programs): AKC dog training programs and resources for obedience and socialization
- [How to Train Your Dog to Walk in Rain or Snow](https://www.akc.org/expert-advice/training/dog-walk-rain-snow): Training guide for acclimating dogs to walking in adverse weather

## Publications & Shop

- [AKC Magazines – American Kennel Club](https://www.akc.org/products-services/magazines): AKC magazine publications on dog breeds, training, shows, and health
- [AKC Shop | Dog Breed Apparel, Supplies & Accessories | AKC Shop](https://shop.akc.org): Official AKC Shop for dog apparel, supplies, and branded merchandise

- [Feature – American Kennel Club](https://www.akc.org/expert-advice/news/feature): In-depth feature stories on dog ownership and issues for dog owners
